invariants.rationale: The method returns the result of execute(), which is expected to return a non-null HoodieCleanMetadata instance.
Clean metadata should never try to retain a commit earlier than the clean instant time.
The clean metadata should record the start time as the instant at which the clean action occurred.
The context is used in the clean operation and is expected to be non-null for a successful clean.
If no partitions are cleaned, no files should be deleted.
